verdict.rationale: Viam's built-in data manager captures component output, including sensor data and telemetry, to the Viam cloud. Data queues locally during network outages and in low-bandwidth environments, then syncs when connectivity returns, with restarts and storage constraints handled automatically. Capture also works for custom driver modules. Missing for 10: documented configurable bandwidth-aware sync policies (e.g., capture frequency, sync intervals, prioritization or filtering rules), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the capture-and-sync pipeline.
